behind their closed-weight counterparts. By 2024, this gap had nearly disappeared.

evidence_items.explanation: Open-weight models nearly matching closed ones points to weak technical barriers. This bears on the state, not the cause.

unresolved_gaps: No source isolates an LLM-only research focus as the cause of model convergence. Other causes, such as open publication, staff moving between labs, and distillation, are not ruled out.
Leaderboard gaps based on Arena Elo measure human preference, not every kind of technical advantage. Whether the moat is 'essentially zero' rather than small is a matter of degree.
